title: Kinetic headline
description: A big editorial headline that builds word by word: rise out of a mask, blur in, scale pop or a wipe. Two faces: *starred words* switch to the condensed display face (or the serif italic, or just the accent colour). Fits the safe area on any aspect.

text.description: The headline. '/' breaks a line; *words* in stars get the emphasis face.

kicker.description: A small mono label above the headline, e.g. 'NO. 01' (empty: none).

style.description: Entrance: rise (words slide up out of a line mask), blur (focus in), pop (letters scale in with a small overshoot), wipe (lines revealed left to right).

emphasis.description: How starred words differ: serif italic, the condensed display face, or only the accent colour.

position.description: Where the block of text sits.

max_size.description: Largest font size, px at 1080 (the text shrinks to fit the safe width).
